items.problem: In the range, the stage of `ogw generation run` (`stageFor`) changed to read the pinned run settings through `runHarnessSettings`. No test runs `generation run` with an open loop run whose pin holds a `measured` that differs from harness settings (tools/test/commands/generation/measure.test.ts:146 and the other `generation run` cases open no run), so a regression to `ctx.settings()` would not fail. This is the `generation run` command, not this target

`blockingMethods` (used by `ogw loop dispatch`) reads the pinned run settings. No test opens a loop run whose pin holds a `measured` or `imageMethod` that differs from harness settings and then checks which methods hold a request back. This is the `loop dispatch` command, not this target
